description: Upload a PNG design (base64-encoded, <=3MB decoded) and receive a durable https url. Pass that url as `design_url` to mu_create_product. Requires `Authorization: Bearer <api_key>`.

data_base64.description: Base64-encoded PNG bytes (a leading data:image/png;base64, prefix is OK). Max ~3MB decoded.

name: mu_upload_design
title: Upload a design image
